qualification_summary: Strong fit for Private VPC. Customer has strict EU residency and audit requirements; use case (regulatory Q&A + embeddings for risk) needs guaranteed isolation and key control. They run multi-AZ Amazon accounts and prefer vendor-deployed software inside their VPC or a VPC peering pattern. Budget allocated but final approval pending security sign-off.
architecture_notes: Target deployment: AWS eu-west-1 (primary), optionally eu-central-1 for DR
Recommended VPC topology: 3 private subnets across AZs for runtime nodes + 1 management/private subnet for control-plane connectors
Inbound: no public inbound except via customer-managed bastion or private VPN; admin API limited to internal CIDRs
Outbound: restricted egress via NAT GW with tight egress rules; allow S3 endpoints and KMS endpoint (AWS-managed or VPC endpoint)
Network connectivity options: VPC endpoint (interface) to Redwood control plane OR AWS Transit Gateway attachment for private deployments; customer prefers TGW
Storage and logs: audit logs to S3 bucket in customer account via Kinesis Firehose; CloudTrail + S3 policy to forward logs to security team
KMS integration: customer will provide a customer-managed CMK (arn provided in workbook). Need Redwood service principal GRANT Encrypt/Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt. Key policy template shared.
Secrets & credentials: secrets stored in customer KMS + AWS Secrets Manager; Redwood requires IAM role with limited STS AssumeRole for short-lived creds
Data residency: all persistent store and token-level logs must remain in EU-only buckets; no token export to non-EU regions
High-availability: autoscaling across AZs + optional cross-region cold standby for DR
security_review_notes: Customer runs annual penetration tests; requires vendor attestation and SOC2 Type II copy
Asked for certificate of encryption in transit + at rest; provided TLS + CMK architecture doc
Audit logging acceptance criteria: 90-day immediate access + 7-year cold retention in Glacier (customer requirement)
Requested explicit revocation flow for KMS key and impact on stored embeddings—raised as blocker for legal
poc_scope: 3-week POC: deploy Private runtime into Cerulean dev VPC (eu-west-1)
Workload: 50k embeddings/day, low-latency chat for compliance search (p95 < 300ms for single-turn queries)
Success criteria: private-only network, KMS-encrypted stores, audit log delivery to S3, basic throughput target met
